text: Marta: quick design sync on bulk-invite modal. two decisions: where to show org-level SSO (inline toggle vs read-only chip), and how to surface an audit shortcut after batch invites. sketches attached. Owen: i lean chip. less visual weight in modal and avoids accidental changes. place left of title with info icon. Gia: accessibility notes: chip must be keyboard focusable and announced. include aria-describedby to a hidden region that explains "SSO is required for this org; change it in Organization settings." add skip-to-audit link for screen reader users. contrast must be >=4.5:1. Rex: implement as a focusable anchor to settings with ?focus=sso so we can highlight and focus the SSO panel. sample: SSO required. avoid mounting a toggle in modal. Owen: copy tweak from security: prefer the verb "required" rather than "enforced". also microcopy for tooltip: "SSO is required for this organization. To change, go to Organization settings." Gia: tooltip must be in DOM and reachable via Enter/Space. announce tooltip content with aria-live or aria-describedby. ensure info icon has accessible name. Marta: audit link: add footer link "View invite activity" -> /orgs/:orgId/audit?filter=invites. add audit metadata on batch events: include field "SSO: required" so rows are self-describing. Rex: i'll prototype html/css + focus behavior and add a11y tests (keyboard + NVDA). will avoid animations on focus transfer. CI-Bot: build queued for feat/bulk-invite-sso-chip at 2112345799 -> https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/7890 Marta: thanks. plan: rex pushes prototype to staging, run keyboard/screen-reader checks, then brief usability test with two admins. leaving notes for SRE on audit field naming. :thumbsup:
